title: IM Gateway · Personal study Bot
discardConfirm: Cancel this queued delivery and unblock later messages. This does not recall a message already received by the platform; an uncertain delivery may already be there. The Web result is kept.
projectionFailures: Projection failures (checkpoint retained; retry every 30 seconds)
intro: Owner-only direct messages; groups and bot messages are rejected. Save a channel, generate a one-time pairing command, and send it from your own IM. Each channel has a separate thread and shares your study library.
autonomous: Autonomous (read/write/sandbox without per-step approval; explicit denials and delete approvals remain)
appSecret: Feishu App Secret (blank keeps saved value)
verifyHint: Only enter a code when requested by the platform
uncertain: The platform may already have received this message. Retrying may send a duplicate. Continue?
secretHint: Credentials and context tokens are encrypted server-side and never returned by ordinary queries.
limits: WeChat reminders depend on a conversation context_token; long-term proactive delivery is not guaranteed. Results remain on the Web. Repeats use elapsed seconds; missed occurrences coalesce once after restart. Times below use your local time and show the IANA zone.
revokeConfirm: Immediately stops linked tasks and cancels reminders and pending deliveries. Pair again to restore access.
threadHint: Select the corresponding IM thread in /bot to view its history and take over.
permissions: Feishu requires an enterprise self-built bot, long-connection subscription im.message.receive_v1, direct receive/send and image/file resource permissions. See deployment documentation.
